title: refactor(ci): split lint/test/release workflows, standardize Node versions & improve caching
author: Aisha Khan
release_notes:
- Split monolithic CI workflow into dedicated lint, test, and release workflows for faster iteration and clearer failure signals.
- Bump CI images to Node 20 and pin actions where possible.
- Improve caching keys and restore stability for cross-repo caching.
- No behaviour changes to runtime code; infra-only refactor.
description:
Motivation: The current single CI workflow has grown to >40 minutes for many PRs and mixes lint/test/release concerns, which makes failures noisy and slows iteration. This PR refactors CI into three focused workflows (lint, test, release), standardizes on Node 20 across workflows, pins/updates several GH Actions to reduce flakes, and improves cache key hygiene so caches are more selective and less collision-prone.

What this does: 1) Introduces .github/workflows/ci-lint.yml and .github/workflows/ci-test.yml to run in parallel for PRs. 2) Moves release automation into .github/workflows/release-publish.yml which only runs on release branches/tags. 3) Updates actions/setup-node to v4, actions/cache to pinned versions, and replaces a couple of community actions with small internal composite actions to reduce third-party surface area. 4) Improves cache keys for node_modules, storybook/cache, and a shared docker-build cache to reduce rebuilds. 5) Adds workflow_dispatch helpers for local/manual runs.

Checklist: 
- [x] Split workflows and move release steps out of PR path
- [x] Pin/update GH Actions and add composite action for node setup
- [x] Validate matrix coverage stays the same for OSS and internal targets
- [x] Run full test matrix and fix failing lint/test flakes
- [x] Update docs/CONTRIBUTING.md CI instructions (small note)

Notes on risk: This is infra-only; no production code behavior changes. The main risk areas were cache misses and subtle differences when using Node 20. I validated the whole test matrix locally and in the cloud and addressed two failures caused by stricter Node 20 linter defaults (fixed in package.json lint config).

See also: Linear ENG-4213 (CI split) and ENG-4289 (cache hygiene).
